limits: Written PCM/source TSV independently measured; finite integer PCM does not certify prequantization floats.
Reported float/block checks are renderer receipts; this scout did not rebuild or rerender candidates.
Spectral occupancy and RMS do not identify perceptual masking, recognition, enjoyment, or artistic success.
Exported bass-approach mute does not replan or alter another musician decision; only keys withholding is a cue-dependency intervention.
Solo buses pass through shared production; their waveforms are not additive pre-master stems.
Three seeds produce only two distinct candidate Score/PCM cases; no held-out generalization established.

baseline_comparison.limits: Different source, arrangement, duration, density and potentially tonal context; narrative teacher tempo138 vs candidate/baseline144. No level normalization or matched source comparison, hence no causal quality/masking/mastering comparison.

analysis_methods.musical_span_rms: Decode stereo PCM16 to [-1,1); root mean square over both channels for first320000frames (16beats144BPM). Perbar bins use rounded exact bar boundary frames. Tail separately measured.
analysis_methods.pcm_comparison: Literal integer sample equality; differing stereo frames count frames where either channel differs. No quality score or waveform MSE.
analysis_methods.score_comparison: Compare ordered TSV events including onset,gate,pitch,velocity,function,duty; pulse filters drum duty=pulse.
analysis_methods.spectra: See candidate_measurements.json; full-file complete1s windows, separately summed stereo power.
analysis_methods.provenance_limits: measure_audio.py is a separate PCM/TSV parser, not independent source composition. Emitted runtime validation/block independence remains emitter testimony.
